easy.def: A word you say when you suddenly understand.
examples: Aha! Now I see.
"Aha!" said the boy.
Aha, I found it!

more.def: A word you say when you suddenly find something out or understand.
examples: "Aha! I know where I left my keys!" said Dad.
"Aha, so that's how the trick works!" said Lily.
She said "Aha!" when the puzzle finally made sense.
The road ahead is clear.
Run ahead, and I will follow.
Look ahead and you will see the barn.

more.def: In front of someone or something, or farther along.
examples: The leader of the hike walked far ahead of the group.
The red car was ahead of us at the light.
We can see the lighthouse straight ahead.

easy.def: Before the time that was planned.
examples: Pack your bag ahead of time.
Call ahead before you visit.
We got there ahead of the others.

more.def: Earlier than something else, or in advance.
examples: She finished the project ahead of the deadline.
Call ahead so the restaurant can save us a table.
Read the chapter ahead of class so you can answer questions.

easy.def: A word sailors call out to get someone's attention.
examples: Ahoy there, friends!
Ahoy, sailor!
"Ahoy!" cried the pirate.

more.def: A word used by sailors to call to another ship or person.
examples: Ahoy there, mates!
The captain called, Ahoy, ship ahead!
A man on the dock shouted, "Ahoy!" as the boat came in.
